concepts.name: Procedural vs OOP, Classes, Objects, __init__ & Methods

criteria.statement: Explains what 'self' refers to inside __init__ and instance methods.
Distinguishes a class (blueprint) from object instances with independent state.

concepts.name: Instance vs Class Variables, Properties & Encapsulation

criteria.statement: Distinguishes per-instance attributes from shared class attributes.
Uses @property getters/setters to enforce validation invariants on attribute assignment.

concepts.name: Inheritance, Method Overriding, Composition & Special Methods

criteria.statement: Applies inheritance with super() and method overriding, and knows when composition ('has-a') is cleaner than inheritance ('is-a').
